summary:
ASTROQUEST is an interactive Mars Exploration Simulator developed by Team ORBITX to make space exploration more engaging, accessible, and educational. Our project provides a mobile-based experience that allows users to explore the Red Planet through an interactive simulation.

The application focuses on introducing users to Mars exploration and creating an engaging way to learn about space and planetary science. We developed a user-friendly interface and packaged the application as an Android APK using modern web and mobile technologies.

Our goal is to encourage curiosity about Mars, inspire interest in space science, and make planetary exploration more accessible through technology. ASTROQUEST represents our effort to bring the excitement of space exploration closer to everyone.
details:
ASTROQUEST is an interactive Mars Exploration Simulator designed to make learning about the Red Planet engaging, accessible, and educational.

The project allows users to explore Mars through a user-friendly digital environment. It aims to introduce users to planetary exploration and space science through an interactive simulation experience.

The application was developed using modern web technologies, including TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. Capacitor was used to package the application for the Android platform.

Key Features:

  • Interactive Mars exploration experience.
  • Space-themed user interface.
  • Educational experience focused on Mars.
  • Android APK support.
  • User-friendly and accessible design.

Technology Stack:

  • Frontend: TypeScript
  • Build Tool: Vite
  • Styling: Tailwind CSS
  • Mobile Framework: Capacitor
  • Platform: Android

Project Impact:

ASTROQUEST aims to encourage curiosity about planetary science, promote interest in space exploration, and make space-related learning more accessible through technology.

The project's creativity lies in combining interactive digital experiences with educational space exploration in a mobile-friendly application.
